keyRules: In the open category, the maximum permitted height is 120 m, measured as the distance to the closest point on the ground surface — not straight down, so near a slope the adjacent terrain may also be taken into account. Within a 50 m radius of a tall artificial obstacle (over 105 m), the entity responsible for the obstacle may apply for permission to fly up to 15 m above the obstacle’s height.

In Finland, the minimum age for a remote pilot is 12 years for drones weighing over 250 grams (Traficom); for C0-class or self-built drones under 250 grams, there is no age or training requirement. Note that the registering operator (user) must always be an adult — for a minor pilot, a guardian registers as the operator.

In the open category, the drone must stay within your own unaided visual line of sight (glasses/contact lenses are fine; binoculars or a screen are not) — or you can fly assisted by an observer, maintaining clear and effective communication with them at all times so that together you can monitor the airspace and avoid collisions. Follow-me mode is a separate exception, permitted at a maximum distance of 50 m from the pilot.
Do not fly over assemblies of people. Rules for uninvolved persons depend on subcategory, class mark and operating conditions; check the official matrix.

Comply with the restrictions of airport CTRs and UAS airspace zones. The zones are defined in Traficom’s regulation OPS M1-29, the latest version of which entered into force on 16 April 2026 — check the current situation on the Fintraffic Sky map (sky.fintraffic.fi).
Night flights are permitted if the drone has a green flashing identification light and visibility is sufficient
There are flight restrictions near the eastern border—check the affected areas before flying
In Lapland, there may be seasonal restrictions in reindeer herding areas
Check area-specific restrictions and altitude limits on the Fintraffic Sky map (sky.fintraffic.fi)
importantNotes: The Eastern Border (EFR100) zone is active 24 hours a day — now visible on the map
Traficom's UAS zones and Natura 2000 areas are shown on the map
In winter, battery capacity decreases in freezing temperatures
The White Night: Long flight times, but be sure to check the restricted areas
Data protection legislation (GDPR) applies to the photographing of identifiable individuals
